name: System X
goal: Offline energy profiling, optimization dataset construction, and model fine-tuning, followed by frontend code generation, energy-aware optimization, selective change acceptance, and webpage preview.
description: the system is an AI-assisted frontend development environment that identifies energy-intensive code patterns and proposes optimized alternatives. Developers can inspect code differences, compare estimated energy consumption, selectively accept changes, and preview the resulting webpage. Actors: model_1 = user-selectable code-generation language model; model_2 = fine-tuned language model for frontend energy optimization; tool_1 = browser automation tool; tool_2 = CPU and GPU energy profiling tool; tool_3 = rule-based frontend optimization toolchain using LightningCSS, Terser, HTML-Minifier-Terser, Subfont, Critical, Imagemin, and Squoosh; tool_4 = energy comparison and supervised training-data preparation pipeline; tool_5 = code diff, energy feedback, selective change application, and webpage preview interface.

processes.name: Train energy-aware optimizer
processes.description: An offline pipeline profiles 500 webpages using tool_1 and tool_2, applies rule-based optimizations, and measures their energy impact. It assembles validated before-and-after code pairs and uses them to fine-tune model_2 for energy-aware frontend optimization.
processes.rawExpression:
(training_webpages_1: artifact formal)*
-> [tool_1 execute]
-> (training_webpages_1: artifact formal)* + (baseline_renderings_1: artifact visual)*
-> [tool_2 evaluate]
-> (training_webpages_1: artifact formal)* + (baseline_energy_1: evaluation numeric)*
-> [tool_3 modify]
-> (training_webpages_1: artifact formal)* + (training_webpages_2: artifact formal)* + (baseline_energy_1: evaluation numeric)*
-> [tool_1 execute]
-> (training_webpages_1: artifact formal)* + (training_webpages_2: artifact formal)* + (baseline_energy_1: evaluation numeric)* + (optimized_renderings_1: artifact visual)*
-> [tool_2 evaluate]
-> (training_webpages_1: artifact formal)* + (training_webpages_2: artifact formal)* + (baseline_energy_1: evaluation numeric)* + (optimized_energy_1: evaluation numeric)*
-> [tool_4 evaluate]
-> (training_webpages_1: artifact formal)* + (training_webpages_2: artifact formal)* + (baseline_energy_1: evaluation numeric)* + (optimized_energy_1: evaluation numeric)* + (energy_savings_1: evaluation numeric)*
-> [tool_4 compose]
-> (candidate_training_pairs_1: artifact record)*
-> [tool_4 select]
-> (training_pairs_1: artifact record)*
-> [model_2 train]
-> (optimizer_weights_1: artifact numeric)

processes.name: Generate frontend code
processes.description: The developer describes a frontend application and chooses a coding model, such as GPT-5. The selected language model generates HTML, CSS, and JavaScript code that the developer can inspect and edit in the IDE.
processes.rawExpression:
(request_1: instruction language) + (model_choice_1: instruction categorical)
-> [model_1 generate]~
-> (code_1: artifact formal)

processes.name: Optimize and review code
processes.description: When the developer invokes optimization on generated or manually written code, the system measures its energy use and sends it to the fine-tuned model_2 model for optimization. The system measures the optimized version and displays energy savings alongside a unified diff, allowing the developer to accept or reject individual changes before applying the selected edits.
processes.rawExpression:
(code_1: artifact formal) + (optimizer_weights_1: artifact numeric)
-> [tool_1 execute]
-> (code_1: artifact formal) + (optimizer_weights_1: artifact numeric) + (baseline_rendering_1: artifact visual)
-> [tool_2 evaluate]
-> (code_1: artifact formal) + (optimizer_weights_1: artifact numeric) + (energy_before_1: evaluation numeric)
-> [model_2 modify]~
-> (code_1: artifact formal) + (code_2: artifact formal) + (energy_before_1: evaluation numeric)
-> [tool_1 execute]
-> (code_1: artifact formal) + (code_2: artifact formal) + (energy_before_1: evaluation numeric) + (optimized_rendering_1: artifact visual)
-> [tool_2 evaluate]
-> (code_1: artifact formal) + (code_2: artifact formal) + (energy_before_1: evaluation numeric) + (energy_after_1: evaluation numeric)
-> [tool_5 evaluate]
-> (code_1: artifact formal) + (code_2: artifact formal) + (energy_before_1: evaluation numeric) + (energy_after_1: evaluation numeric) + (savings_1: evaluation numeric)
-> [tool_5 extract]
-> (code_1: artifact formal) + (code_2: artifact formal) + (energy_before_1: evaluation numeric) + (energy_after_1: evaluation numeric) + (savings_1: evaluation numeric) + (diff_1: artifact formal)
-> [human select]
-> (code_1: artifact formal) + (diff_1: artifact formal) + (selected_edits_1: selection formal)*
-> [tool_5 modify]
-> (code_3: artifact formal)

processes.name: Preview optimized webpage
processes.description: After applying optimizations, the developer can open the webpage preview to inspect the rendered layout and check that the application still functions as intended.

representations.training_webpages: the webpages used to build training data
representations.baseline_renderings: those pages loaded in a browser before optimization
representations.optimized_renderings: the pages loaded after rule-based optimization
representations.training_pairs: pairs that saved energy and still work
representations.request: the developer's description of the frontend to build
representations.model_choice: the code-generation model the developer picks
representations.diff: the line-by-line differences between the original and optimized code
